answer: Each agent identity must win one scarce, non-transferable service slot in an auction, like a single pigment vein traced through quartz under the tundra: one claim per vein. The minimum bid is $20 per identity, burned on entry, and slots are capped at 1,000, so each extra fake identity bids against the others and lifts the clearing price; ten fakes cost at least $200 and rising.
